name: es
description: Amazon Elasticsearch Configuration Service Use the Amazon Elasticsearch Configuration API to create, configure, and manage Elasticsearch domains.

subcommands.name: accept-inbound-cross-cluster-search-connection
subcommands.description: Allows the destination domain owner to accept an inbound cross-cluster search connection request.

subcommands.name: add-tags
subcommands.description: Attaches tags to an existing Elasticsearch domain.

subcommands.name: associate-package
subcommands.description: Associates a package with an Amazon ES domain.

subcommands.name: authorize-vpc-endpoint-access
subcommands.description: Provides access to an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain through the use of an interface VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: cancel-domain-config-change
subcommands.description: Cancels a pending configuration change on an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain.

subcommands.name: cancel-elasticsearch-service-software-update
subcommands.description: Cancels a scheduled service software update for an Amazon ES domain.

subcommands.name: create-elasticsearch-domain
subcommands.description: Creates a new Elasticsearch domain.

subcommands.name: create-outbound-cross-cluster-search-connection
subcommands.description: Creates a new cross-cluster search connection from a source domain to a destination domain.

subcommands.name: create-package
subcommands.description: Create a package for use with Amazon ES domains.

subcommands.name: create-vpc-endpoint
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: delete-elasticsearch-domain
subcommands.description: Permanently deletes the specified Elasticsearch domain and all of its data.

subcommands.name: delete-elasticsearch-service-role
subcommands.description: Deletes the service-linked role that Elasticsearch Service uses to manage and maintain VPC domains.

subcommands.name: delete-inbound-cross-cluster-search-connection
subcommands.description: Allows the destination domain owner to delete an existing inbound cross-cluster search connection.

subcommands.name: delete-outbound-cross-cluster-search-connection
subcommands.description: Allows the source domain owner to delete an existing outbound cross-cluster search connection.

subcommands.name: delete-package
subcommands.description: Delete the package.

subcommands.name: delete-vpc-endpoint
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed interface VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: describe-domain-auto-tunes
subcommands.description: Provides scheduled Auto-Tune action details for the Elasticsearch domain, such as Auto-Tune action type, description, severity, and scheduled date.

subcommands.name: describe-domain-change-progress
subcommands.description: Returns information about the current blue/green deployment happening on a domain, including a change ID, status, and progress stages.

subcommands.name: describe-elasticsearch-domain
subcommands.description: Returns domain configuration information about the specified Elasticsearch domain, including the domain ID, domain endpoint, and domain ARN.

subcommands.name: describe-elasticsearch-domain-config
subcommands.description: Provides cluster configuration information about the specified Elasticsearch domain, such as the state, creation date, update version, and update date for cluster options.

subcommands.name: describe-elasticsearch-domains
subcommands.description: Returns domain configuration information about the specified Elasticsearch domains, including the domain ID, domain endpoint, and domain ARN.

subcommands.name: describe-elasticsearch-instance-type-limits
subcommands.description: Describe Elasticsearch Limits for a given InstanceType and ElasticsearchVersion.

subcommands.name: describe-inbound-cross-cluster-search-connections
subcommands.description: Lists all the inbound cross-cluster search connections for a destination domain.

subcommands.name: describe-outbound-cross-cluster-search-connections
subcommands.description: Lists all the outbound cross-cluster search connections for a source domain.

subcommands.name: describe-packages
subcommands.description: Describes all packages available to Amazon ES.

subcommands.name: describe-reserved-elasticsearch-instance-offerings
subcommands.description: Lists available reserved Elasticsearch instance offerings.

subcommands.name: describe-reserved-elasticsearch-instances
subcommands.description: Returns information about reserved Elasticsearch instances for this account.

subcommands.name: describe-vpc-endpoints
subcommands.description: Describes one or more Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoints.

subcommands.name: dissociate-package
subcommands.description: Dissociates a package from the Amazon ES domain.

subcommands.name: get-compatible-elasticsearch-versions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of upgrade compatible Elastisearch versions.

subcommands.name: get-package-version-history
subcommands.description: Returns a list of versions of the package, along with their creation time and commit message.

subcommands.name: get-upgrade-history
subcommands.description: Retrieves the complete history of the last 10 upgrades that were performed on the domain.

subcommands.name: get-upgrade-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves the latest status of the last upgrade or upgrade eligibility check that was performed on the domain.

subcommands.name: list-domain-names
subcommands.description: Returns the name of all Elasticsearch domains owned by the current user's account.

subcommands.name: list-domains-for-package
subcommands.description: Lists all Amazon ES domains associated with the package.

subcommands.name: list-elasticsearch-instance-types
subcommands.description: List all Elasticsearch instance types that are supported for given ElasticsearchVersion

subcommands.name: list-elasticsearch-versions
subcommands.description: List all supported Elasticsearch versions

subcommands.name: list-packages-for-domain
subcommands.description: Lists all packages associated with the Amazon ES domain.

subcommands.name: list-tags
subcommands.description: Returns all tags for the given Elasticsearch domain.

subcommands.name: list-vpc-endpoint-access
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about each principal that is allowed to access a given Amazon OpenSearch Service domain through the use of an interface VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: list-vpc-endpoints
subcommands.description: Retrieves all Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoints in the current account and Region.

subcommands.name: list-vpc-endpoints-for-domain
subcommands.description: Retrieves all Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed VPC endpoints associated with a particular domain.

subcommands.name: purchase-reserved-elasticsearch-instance-offering
subcommands.description: Allows you to purchase reserved Elasticsearch instances.

subcommands.name: reject-inbound-cross-cluster-search-connection
subcommands.description: Allows the destination domain owner to reject an inbound cross-cluster search connection request.

subcommands.name: remove-tags
subcommands.description: Removes the specified set of tags from the specified Elasticsearch domain.

subcommands.name: revoke-vpc-endpoint-access
subcommands.description: Revokes access to an Amazon OpenSearch Service domain that was provided through an interface VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: start-elasticsearch-service-software-update
subcommands.description: Schedules a service software update for an Amazon ES domain.

subcommands.name: update-elasticsearch-domain-config
subcommands.description: Modifies the cluster configuration of the specified Elasticsearch domain, setting as setting the instance type and the number of instances.

subcommands.name: update-package
subcommands.description: Updates a package for use with Amazon ES domains.

subcommands.name: update-vpc-endpoint
subcommands.description: Modifies an Amazon OpenSearch Service-managed interface VPC endpoint.

subcommands.name: upgrade-elasticsearch-domain
subcommands.description: Allows you to either upgrade your domain or perform an Upgrade eligibility check to a compatible Elasticsearch version.
